instrument.model: modulation-difference energy and concentration under additive resynthesis

params.name: subset_size
params.why: how many coincident bins are split. This is the CONCENTRATION knob -- more bins at more distinct beat rates spreads the modulation difference across bands

params.name: beat_rates_hz
params.why: distinct rates so split bins land in different 1.0 Hz bands; if they coincided, subset size would stop controlling spread

params.name: concentration_stat
params.why: the configuration brocot_cue_salience NAMED IN ADVANCE, not the one that scored highest there -- taking the max is the defect the swing rule was minted to prevent, and this cell inherits that cell's question and so inherits its pre-registration

params.name: band_width_hz
params.why: 1.0 Hz, the width every other cell in this line uses; changing it here would break comparability with the salience result this battery exists to decide

params.name: seed
params.why: subsets are sampled, so the battery is a random object and must be reproducible; the repo's BASE_SEED

params.name: duration_s
params.why: 2 s resolves 0.5 Hz, half the band width, so a beat cannot straddle two bands unresolved

|rho| between energy and concentration i.name: |rho| between energy and concentration in the FM detune family
|rho| between energy and concentration i.why: a Spearman magnitude; 0 and 1 are both attainable, and if the FM family is ALREADY decorrelated this battery is unnecessary

matched-energy pairs differing in concen.name: matched-energy pairs differing in concentration
matched-energy pairs differing in concen.why: a count of within-ratio pairs; the ceiling is every pair in every ratio and 0 is attainable if the plane cannot be spanned

matched-concentration pairs differing in.name: matched-concentration pairs differing in energy
matched-concentration pairs differing in.why: the same count in the other direction, on the same ceiling

|rho| over the constructed battery.name: |rho| over the constructed battery
|rho| over the constructed battery.rival: the FM detune family this battery replaces
|rho| over the constructed battery.why: a Spearman magnitude on the pooled battery; 0 is attainable by construction and 1 by a battery that failed to decorrelate

battery members whose amplitude multiset.name: battery members whose amplitude multiset differs from exact
battery members whose amplitude multiset.why: a count over every rendered member; every one is meant to be a pure frequency move

ratios where BOTH matched-pair families.name: ratios where BOTH matched-pair families exist within the ratio
ratios where BOTH matched-pair families.why: a count over the 11 ratios; pooling across ratios manufactures spread, so the contrast must be constructible inside one

amendment1.diagnosis: subset size is not a concentration knob: the modulation difference is broadband and its concentration is near-saturated regardless of k, while amplitudes span three decades so subset choice moves energy by up to 1e11. The battery reproduced the one-knob defect it was built to remove.
amendment1.untested_condition: same-rate splitting (k bins at ONE beat rate) never appears in this battery; its absence is not evidence about it
